resources.string: Asks for a tap when Android blocks the call volume boost while Earshot is closed.
Tap to boost the call volume
Android only lets Earshot change the call volume while Earshot is open. Tap to open it and boost this call.
Android blocked the call volume boost because Earshot wasn\'t open. Open Earshot, or tap its notification, during the call to boost it.
Android closed Earshot in the night and won\'t let it play sounds in the background. Tap to resume sounds.
Android closed Earshot in the night. The sounds wait for a tap on the notification.
